text:
Marta: heads-up — spotted a KPI name mismatch in the Console docs. dashboard JSON and the TypeScript SDK snippet still reference `requests_per_min` but the metrics service moved to `rps`. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412

Kevin: saw that. linter in docs-ci flagged `kpiName` when embedding the snippet into the sample app. the dashboard import fails with `Unknown metric slug: requests_per_min`.

Marta: metrics-service renamed slugs in v2 last year — we should add a migration note. short plan: update the dashboard JSON, update the TS snippet, and add a compatibility note in migration guide. keep alias for 1 release?

Raj: I can prepare a tiny patch. will update `dashboards/kpis.json` and `docs/snippets/typescript/metrics-sample.ts`. question: do we want a backward-compat alias in the console runtime or just docs?

Olivia: prefer docs-first: add a clear migration snippet showing old->new, and keep a console alias for one release to avoid breaking customers immediately. also update the screenshot label (Requests / min -> RPS).

Raj: pushing a branch now. steps I used: 
```bash
git checkout -b docs/kpi-rename-fix
# edit dashboards/kpis.json and docs/snippets/typescript/metrics-sample.ts
git add dashboards/kpis.json docs/snippets/typescript/metrics-sample.ts
git commit -m "docs: rename requests_per_min -> rps and update TS snippet"
git push origin docs/kpi-rename-fix
```

Docbot: deploy-preview build queued: https://deploy-preview-412--docs.redwood-inference.com — CI will run docs lint and snippet extraction.

Kevin: also noticed the Console screenshots still show the old label; file is `static/img/console/kpis-screenshot.png`. we should update before merging PR so screenshot doesn't mislead.

Marta: I'll update the image after the JSON changes land. can someone add a tiny tests for the snippet parser so this doesn't regress?

Raj: adding `docs/snippets/tests/ts-snippet-parse.test.ts` to assert the snippet compiles and the metric slug maps to `rps`. will attach test in the PR.

Olivia: also found an outbound link in the migration guide that 404s (old path `/dashboards/kpis`). please change to `/console/dashboards/kpis` and add a redirect note.

Marta: assigning reviewers: @Kevin @Olivia. tagging @Docbot to run the docs checklist.

Docbot: REVIEWERS: Kevin, Olivia; CI STATUS: pending; TODO: screenshot updated, migration note added.

Kevin: LGTM on the plan. please remember to add an entry to the docs changelog under "Console" -> "KPI rename guidance".

Olivia: I'll draft the migration snippet showing both the old and new example config and a brief note on timeline.

Marta: thanks — once deploy preview is green and screenshots updated i'll merge. :thumbsup:

Raj: merged at 1744446789 — PR #412 merged. thanks everyone for quick turnaround.
